t: This is Elephant & Castle tube station, in the London Borough of Southwark, in zones 1 and 2. It's served by two lines: the Bank branch of the Northern line, which opened here in 1890, and the Bakerloo line, where it is the southern terminus, opened sixteen years later. The Bakerloo station was designed by Leslie Green, the architect best known for the stations he designed on the Underground in the 1900s, with distinctive oxblood red tiled fronts and semicircular first-floor windows. There's an interchange with the nearby National Rail station.
